se_tip.confirm_delete: Really delete the goal “%{name}”? The amount collected so far goes with it.
se_tip.empty: No donation goal yet. Create one – donations always go to the topmost.
se_tip.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to StreamElements. Please wait a moment.
se_tip.error.unauthorized: StreamElements rejects the access. The token is probably no longer valid.
se_tip.error.unknown_channel: StreamElements does not know this channel ID.
se_tip.how_first: On the first run nothing is added retroactively – only donations from now on count. Otherwise a whole year of history would land on the first goal.
se_tip.how_poll: Polled every %{seconds} seconds – as long as the background process ticks that often. By default that is 15 seconds; to really get the shorter interval, set WORKER_INTERVAL=5 in the .env.
se_tip.how_target: Every donation goes to the topmost goal in the list. Once it is full, move it down or delete it.
se_tip.name: StreamElements Tip Goals
se_tip.no_credentials: No StreamElements access is stored yet – that is why the goals do not grow on their own.
se_tip.perm.edit: may create, change, move and delete donation goals and store the access data.
se_tip.settings_lead: Token and channel ID used to fetch the donations.
se_tip.title: Name
se_tip.token_set: stored – leave empty to keep it
se_tip.token_where: The token is in StreamElements under “Account → Show secrets” as the JWT token, the channel ID next to it.
se_tip.too_many: More than %{max} goals is no longer a list.
